scope: One January publication per year where listed in 2015 through 2025. Every CSV header and up to three rows matched a generated reader. All ancillary-service disclosure rows were decoded and compared with independent CSV row counts. COP updates were checked only through headers and up to three rows. Empty January COP listings before 2020 and reused January 2020 observations are recorded. This is not proof of continuous retention, all historical layouts or numerical correctness of every field.
